items.name: P08a 9th page-verdict value `not_assessable` vs locked 8-value R-015 (C01 spec-locked) and X39 page_review_state
items.situation: C01 was ruled 'R-015 as locked: 8 values', and P08a adds a 9th value to the same column. X39 already records `no_usable_text` / `fetch_failed` as a deterministic page_review_state, so a page with no usable text would carry the 'not assessable' fact twice, once as a jev verdict that jev cannot produce from empty text. The procurement and text pipelines' 'not assessable' outcomes are record-level and document-level, not page verdicts.

items.name: Rulings that make the extractor select or classify (C-001)
items.situation: C-001 says the extractor is not a classifier. Under X12 alt-1 the extractor decides, blind to jev's code, which passages are relevant to each field; when it returns nothing, R-041 downgrades the code, so the extractor's judgement of relevance sets the published value. C13 alt-1 has the extractor pick which named organisation is 'the supplier', P04a needs a supplier role, and X26 has the extractor choose a publication date when metadata is absent: each is a selection among candidates rather than verbatim copying.

options.label: jev selects, extractor lists candidates
options.mechanism: Extractor returns every candidate span (all organisation names, all dates, all passages) and jev answers a Choice over them (the C16 pattern); X12 becomes 'extract all candidate passages, jev picks'.
options.benefits: Keeps C-001 literal; one mechanism for every selection.
options.risks: More jev calls and dynamic choice sets per request; candidate lists may be long on big pages.
options.commits_to: T-011 dynamic-choice design, T-022/T-032 prompt changes, T-002 cost sizing.

options.label: Permit named selection acts in C-001
options.mechanism: Amend C-001 to list the selection acts the extractor may perform (relevant-passage selection, supplier naming, date pick), each with its supporting quote and a support check.
options.benefits: Rulings stand as chosen; simpler pipeline.
options.risks: C-001 weakens from a rule to a list; the extractor's silence still decides some codes.
options.commits_to: SPEC delta to C-001 (PI); T-031 review scope widened.

options.label: X12 reverts to R-040; other selections via (a)
options.mechanism: Quotes are requested after jev codes (R-040 as locked); X35 entailment still runs; C13/P04/X26 selections go through jev Choice.
options.benefits: Removes the silence-decides-code path while keeping X35.

options.commits_to: Re-ruling X12; T-022/T-032 unchanged on R-040.

items.situation: C-007 counts version steps of one contract. RC-D-002 gives every codebook item its own version, P15a adds a mandatory codebook_version, and the text contract carries semver 1.0.0 while procurement pins 2.0. items.name: P06a `attribution_role` on core rows vs N-005 / C-005 and the C04/A05 grain rules
items.situation: P06a puts contracting authority / beneficiary / central purchasing body on core rows, and its own risk text says it 'changes core grain semantics'. If a central purchasing body's award is attributed to beneficiary agencies, rows would appear for institutions that were not searched, which N-005 (no automatic attribution transfers) and C-005 (never add to the searched denominator) bar. C04 alt-1 and A05 already encode unit / parent / joint relations, A05 internally only.
